name: mode-tool-use-rule
title: The mode rule: run the tool you have, and a script you write is meant to be used twice
description: The owner's requirement, decided on 2026-10-05: a mode's machine tools are not hard prerequisites - nothing should refuse or gate a mode for their absence - but the agent must actually invoke a tool the work needs rather than plan or narrate it, and a script it writes instead must be general enough to reuse. The requirement lands in the mode files as mode rules (code-development Method, code-audit Method, pentest During the run), each held by a case that asserts the body states it. Trading is deliberately out: its surface is order submission with a derived id, not scripts. Drops the load-time machine-tool check that 10-03-mode-prerequisites had planned.
